saascity.description: SaaSCity remote MCP server (streamable HTTP, keyless, no account or API key required for read-only tools). Runs a 16-point static HTML pre-launch readiness audit, filters 1,600+ startup and AI directories by live Ahrefs Domain Rating (DR), link type, pricing, and badge requirements, checks whether a live directory listing renders a followed backlink, searches live SaaSCity launches, and computes SaaS metrics (ARR, churn, NRR, Rule of 40, NPS, A/B significance). Docs: https://saascity.io/mcp

saascity.name: check_launch_readiness
saascity.title: Check launch readiness
saascity.description: Audit a product homepage across 16 static HTML launch checks (HTTPS, noindex, title, description, OG image, canonical, robots.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD).

saascity.name: recommend_launch_directories
saascity.title: Recommend launch directories
saascity.description: Return a curated set of startup, SaaS, AI, or developer tool launch directories with editorial notes and free/paid routes.

saascity.name: find_launch_directories
saascity.title: Find launch directories
saascity.description: Filter 1,600+ startup and AI directories by Ahrefs Domain Rating, dofollow vs nofollow link type, pricing, and badge-exchange requirements.

saascity.name: get_launch_directory
saascity.title: Get launch directory details
saascity.description: Inspect one directory by domain for DR, link type, pricing, badge requirement, submit URL, and audit notes.

saascity.name: check_backlink
saascity.title: Check live backlink
saascity.description: Fetch a live directory listing URL and inspect whether it renders a followed, nofollow, redirect, or missing link to your domain.

saascity.name: search_listings
saascity.title: Search SaaSCity listings
saascity.description: Search live SaaS and AI product launches in the SaaSCity directory.
